correspondences.notes: Lacks *_meg.json and coordsystem.json (REQUIRED) and channels/events (proposed); scans.tsv is session-level.

brainlife.desc: Raw MEG from a 4D Neuroimaging/BTi system: a run folder of extension-less files (config, hs_file, data).
brainlife.name: neuro/meg/BTi4D

original.desc: Each experimental run on a 4D neuroimaging/BTi system results in a folder containing multiple files without extensions.

file_descs.meg: A directory containing the following files; "config", "hs_file", "e,rfhp1.0Hz.COH", "c,rfDC"

brainlife.readme:
**Use for:** Archiving raw BTi/4D MEG runs for later conversion.

**Not for:** Processing on brainlife.io: no App reads this datatype yet.

**BIDS:** meg/meg (partial)

**Sharing:** Tier 3 (directly identifiable or traceable) by default.

Full record: https://github.com/brainlife/abcd-spec/blob/master/datatypes/neuro.meg.BTi4D.json

files.desc: A directory containing the following files; "config", "hs_file", "e,rfhp1.0Hz.COH", "c,rfDC"
BIDS scans.tsv listing acquisition times of runs.
Channel names, types, units and status.
Coordinate system and fiducials for sensor positions.

identifying_risks: BTi config and hs_file can hold participant name and acquisition date; scans.tsv holds acquisition times.
Recording dates and free-text fields in sidecars or events.
governance.rationale: Tool 1 step 5: raw EEG/MEG headers can hold participant identity and acquisition dates; the more protective tier holds until they are scrubbed.
sharing_cautions: Anonymise headers (e.g. mne-bids anonymize) before sharing outside a controlled project.
tier_conditions: Tier 2 once the BTi header and sidecars are anonymised (no names, birth dates, recording dates).

intended_use: Archiving raw BTi/4D MEG runs for later conversion.
not_suitable_for: Processing on brainlife.io: no App reads this datatype yet.
